description:
Search the NobleBlocks paper index by keyword relevance.

        Returns up to `limit` papers with title, authors, year, journal, DOI, citation count,
        an abstract excerpt and a NobleBlocks link. Use get_paper with a result's `id` for
        full metadata, or get_citation to cite it.

query.description: Topic, question, title words or author name. Supports AND / OR / NOT and "quoted phrases".
query.title: Query

year_from.description: Only papers published in or after this year.
year_from.title: Year From

year_to.description: Only papers published in or before this year.
year_to.title: Year To

name: search_papers
title: Search papers
